grammar.pattern: 的话 / 等：条件与列举
grammar.purpose: Read the whole phrase instead of its literal pieces
grammar.explanation: 有空的话 introduces a condition, not somebody’s spoken words. 药片、药水等 is a non-exhaustive list, not an instruction to wait. Compare 等一会儿, the waiting verb in another context. Neither an open list nor a condition provides missing doses, dates or permission.

examples.zh: 方便的话，我来坐一会儿。
examples.py: fāng biàn de huà , wǒ lái zuò yī huì er .
examples.en: If convenient, I will come and sit a while.

examples.py: yào piàn , yào shuǐ děng dōu xiān fàng hǎo .
examples.en: Put the tablets, liquid medicine and so on properly in place first.

examples.zh: 等一会儿，再问她方便不方便。
examples.py: děng yī huì er , zài wèn tā fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
examples.en: Wait a while, then ask whether it is convenient for her.

commonMistakes.wrong: 有空的话，所以我一定来。意思是还要看方便不方便。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the visit conditional instead of asserting certain arrival.

grammar.pattern: 不一会儿：短时间后的变化
grammar.explanation: 不一会儿电话响了 describes a short interval before a change. It does not mean an exact five minutes. 坐一会儿 states a short duration of sitting; 不一会儿…了 introduces what happens afterward. If the visit needs an exact end time, ask and state it separately.

examples.py: bù yī huì er , tā huí le xiāo xī .
examples.en: A little later, she replied to the message.

examples.py: wǒ zuò yī huì er jiù zǒu .
examples.en: I will sit a short while and then leave.

examples.zh: 五点离开，这是确认的时间。
examples.py: wǔ diǎn lí kāi , zhè shì què rèn de shí jiān .
examples.en: Leave at five; that is the confirmed time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不一会儿一定就是五分钟。
commonMistakes.right: 不一会儿说的是短时间，不是准确分钟。
commonMistakes.why: The expression itself does not supply an exact duration.

grammar.purpose: Open a telephone call and identify yourself
grammar.explanation: 喂，你好，我是… can open a call. Use the stated greeting and identify yourself, then ask whether speaking is convenient. Do not read it as 喂动物 feed animals, another full-tone reading and meaning. A greeting is not consent to a long call; allow the listener to decline.

examples.py: wèi , nǐ hǎo , wǒ shì xiǎo wáng .
xiàn zài fāng biàn shuō huà ma ?
examples.en: Is it convenient to talk now?

examples.zh: 不方便的话，我晚点儿再联系。
examples.py: bù fāng biàn de huà , wǒ wǎn diǎn ér zài lián xì .
examples.en: If inconvenient, I will contact you later.

commonMistakes.why: The greeting should not become a demand for an uninterrupted call.

dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 喂，你好，我是小王。现在方便说话吗？
lines.py: wèi , nǐ hǎo , wǒ shì xiǎo wáng . xiàn zài fāng biàn shuō huà ma ?
lines.en: Hello, it's Xiao Wang. Is now a good time to talk?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 方便。我已经出院，在家休息了。
lines.py: fāng biàn . wǒ yǐ jīng chū yuàn , zài jiā xiū xī le .
lines.en: Yes. I've left hospital and am resting at home.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有空的话，我今天来坐一会儿？
lines.py: yǒu kōng de huà , wǒ jīn tiān lái zuò yī huì er ?
lines.en: If you're free, may I visit briefly today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，四点半来吧。我五点想睡一会儿。
lines.py: hǎo , sì diǎn bàn lái ba . wǒ wǔ diǎn xiǎng shuì yī huì er .
lines.en: Sure, come at four thirty. I'd like a nap at five.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。你想看哪本书？我带过来。
lines.py: xíng . nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ běn shū ? wǒ dài guò lái .
lines.en: Okay. Which book would you like? I'll bring it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 就上次那本小说吧，我一直没看完。
lines.py: jiù shàng cì nà běn xiǎo shuō ba , wǒ yì zhí méi kàn wán .
lines.en: That novel from last time. I still haven't finished it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我找一下，不一会儿就能找到。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ zhǎo yī xià , bù yī huì er jiù néng zhǎo dào .
lines.en: Sure. I'll look for it; it shouldn't take long.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 慢慢找。我还在等你发书的照片呢。
lines.py: màn màn zhǎo . wǒ hái zài děng nǐ fā shū de zhào piān ne .
lines.en: Take your time. I'm still waiting for your photo of it.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A considerate short visit
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 朋友已经出院，今天在家休息。我打电话问现在方不方便说话，她说可以，声音也比上次轻松了。
lines.py: péng you yǐ jīng chū yuàn , jīn tiān zài jiā xiū xī . wǒ dǎ diàn huà wèn xiàn zài fāng bù fāng biàn shuō huà , tā shuō kě yǐ , shēng yīn yě bǐ shàng cì qīng sōng le .
lines.en: My friend had left hospital and was resting at home. I called to ask if it was a good time to talk. It was, and she sounded more relaxed than last time.

lines.zh: 我们约好四点半见，五点我就走。她想睡一会儿，我也还有事，所以坐半小时正好。
lines.py: wǒ men yuē hǎo sì diǎn bàn jiàn , wǔ diǎn wǒ jiù zǒu . tā xiǎng shuì yī huì er , wǒ yě hái yǒu shì , suǒ yǐ zuò bàn xiǎo shí zhèng hǎo .
lines.en: We arranged to meet at four thirty and for me to leave at five. She wanted a nap, and I had other plans too, so half an hour suited us.

lines.zh: 她想继续看上次的小说，我就在书架上找。不一会儿找到了，可是夹在里面的纸掉了出来，上面还有她写的两句话。
lines.py: tā xiǎng jì xù kàn shàng cì de xiǎo shuō , wǒ jiù zài shū jià shàng zhǎo . bù yī huì er zhǎo dào le , kě shì jiā zài lǐ miàn de zhǐ diào le chū lái , shàng miàn hái yǒu tā xiě de liǎng jù huà .
lines.en: She wanted to carry on reading the novel from last time. I found it on the bookshelf shortly afterwards, but a sheet slipped out with two sentences she'd written.

lines.zh: 我把书和纸一起拍给她看，她说就是这本，纸也别忘了带。我把它放回书里，再把书放进包里。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ shū hé zhǐ yì qǐ pāi gěi tā kàn , tā shuō jiù shì zhè běn , zhǐ yě bié wàng le dài . wǒ bǎ tā fàng huí shū lǐ , zài bǎ shū fàng jìn bāo lǐ .
lines.en: I sent her a photo of the book and paper. It was the right one, and she asked me to bring the paper too. I put it back inside the book and put the book in my bag.

lines.zh: 四点半到她家时，太阳已经照到窗边。她坐在椅子上，我们聊了小说里的朋友，也说了下次去哪家书店。
lines.py: sì diǎn bàn dào tā jiā shí , tài yáng yǐ jīng zhào dào chuāng biān . tā zuò zài yǐ zi shàng , wǒ men liáo le xiǎo shuō lǐ de péng you , yě shuō le xià cì qù nǎ jiā shū diàn .
lines.en: At four thirty the sun was shining by her window. We sat and chatted about the friends in the novel and which bookshop to visit next time.

lines.zh: 快五点时，我先告别。走到楼下，她还发来消息，说我带对了书，却忘了把自己的围巾带走。
lines.py: kuài wǔ diǎn shí , wǒ xiān gào bié . zǒu dào lóu xià , tā hái fā lái xiāo xī , shuō wǒ dài duì le shū , què wàng le bǎ zì jǐ de wéi jīn dài zǒu .
lines.en: Just before five I said goodbye. When I got downstairs she messaged: I'd brought the right book but forgotten to take my own scarf.

choices: The right novel arrives but a scarf is left behind
The visitor cannot find the home

choices: To check it is the one the friend wants
To ask for the time of discharge

lines.zh: 你今天带了书，却把围巾留下了。
lines.py: nǐ jīn tiān dài le shū , què bǎ wéi jīn liú xià le .
lines.en: You brought the book but left your scarf.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我下次来拿，行吗？
lines.py: wǒ xià cì lái ná , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Can I get it next time?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，我先放门边。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ xiān fàng mén biān .
lines.en: Sure. I'll put it by the door.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 别放太远，我下次可能又忘。
lines.py: bié fàng tài yuǎn , wǒ xià cì kě néng yòu wàng .
lines.en: Don't put it too far away. I might forget again.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我也给围巾拍张照片。
lines.py: nà wǒ yě gěi wéi jīn pāi zhāng zhào piān .

lines.zh: 好，看到照片我就想起来了。
lines.py: hǎo , kàn dào zhào piān wǒ jiù xiǎng qǐ lái le .

lines.en: A new pharmacy opened downstairs.

lines.zh: 药店就在车站旁边。
lines.py: yào diàn jiù zài chē zhàn páng biān .
lines.en: The pharmacy is beside the station.

lines.zh: 药片放在小盒子里。
lines.py: yào piàn fàng zài xiǎo hé zi lǐ .
lines.en: The tablets are in a small box.

lines.zh: 她把药片的盒子收进包里。
lines.py: tā bǎ yào piàn de hé zi shōu jìn bāo lǐ .
lines.en: She put the tablet box away in her bag.

lines.zh: 瓶子上写着药水两个字。
lines.py: píng zi shàng xiě zhe yào shuǐ liǎng gè zì .
lines.en: The bottle is labelled with the word for liquid medicine.

lines.zh: 那瓶药水放在柜子里。
lines.py: nà píng yào shuǐ fàng zài guì zi lǐ .
lines.en: That bottle of liquid medicine is in the cupboard.

lines.zh: 她家里养了一只猫。
lines.py: tā jiā lǐ yǎng le yī zhǐ māo .
lines.en: She keeps a cat at home.

lines.zh: 爷爷很喜欢养花。
lines.py: yé ye hěn xǐ huān yǎng huā .
lines.en: My grandfather loves growing flowers.

lines.zh: 雨太大，我全身都湿了。
lines.py: yǔ tài dà , wǒ quán shēn dōu shī le .
lines.en: The rain was so heavy I was wet all over.

lines.zh: 跑完以后，他全身都是汗。
lines.py: pǎo wán yǐ hòu , tā quán shēn dōu shì hàn .
lines.en: He was sweating all over after the run.

lines.zh: 我闻到了饭的香味。
lines.py: wǒ wén dào le fàn de xiāng wèi .
lines.en: I smelled the aroma of cooked food.

lines.zh: 她拿起花闻了闻。
lines.py: tā ná qǐ huā wén le wén .
lines.en: She picked up the flower and smelled it.

lines.zh: 今天早上的空气很好。
lines.py: jīn tiān zǎo shàng de kōng qì hěn hǎo .
lines.en: The air is pleasant this morning.

lines.zh: 打开窗户，屋里的空气好多了。
lines.py: dǎ kāi chuāng hù , wū lǐ de kōng qì hǎo duō le .
lines.en: Opening the window made the indoor air much better.

lines.zh: 这本书讲了地球的变化。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiǎng le dì qiú de biàn huà .
lines.en: This book describes changes on Earth.

lines.zh: 老师在图上指出地球的位置。
lines.py: lǎo shī zài tú shàng zhǐ chū dì qiú de wèi zhì .
lines.en: The teacher pointed to Earth on the diagram.

lines.zh: 太阳出来了，我们去走走吧。
lines.py: tài yáng chū lái le , wǒ men qù zǒu zǒu ba .
lines.en: The sun's out. Let's go for a walk.

lines.zh: 太阳下山以后，风凉了。
lines.py: tài yáng xià shān yǐ hòu , fēng liáng le .
lines.en: It became cooler after sunset.

lines.zh: 今晚的月亮很圆。
lines.py: jīn wǎn de yuè liàng hěn yuán .
lines.en: The moon is round tonight.

lines.zh: 她拍了一张月亮的照片。
lines.py: tā pāi le yī zhāng yuè liàng de zhào piān .
lines.en: She took a photo of the moon.

lines.zh: 天上有很多星星。
lines.py: tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō xīng xīng .
lines.en: There are lots of stars in the sky.

lines.zh: 云太多，今天看不到星星。
lines.py: yún tài duō , jīn tiān kàn bù dào xīng xīng .
lines.en: It's too cloudy to see stars today.

lines.zh: 那天夜里，我一直睡不着。
lines.py: nà tiān yè lǐ , wǒ yì zhí shuì bù zhe .
lines.en: I couldn't sleep that night.

lines.zh: 夜已经很深了，我们明天再聊吧。
lines.py: yè yǐ jīng hěn shēn le , wǒ men míng tiān zài liáo ba .
lines.en: It's very late. Let's chat tomorrow.

lines.zh: 天上有一片云。
lines.py: tiān shàng yǒu yī piàn yún .
lines.en: There's a cloud in the sky.

lines.zh: 孩子抬头看天上的飞机。
lines.py: hái zi tái tóu kàn tiān shàng de fēi jī .
lines.en: The child looked up at a plane in the sky.

lines.zh: 你想选哪个月份去旅行？
lines.py: nǐ xiǎng xuǎn nǎ gè yuè fèn qù lǚ xíng ?
lines.en: Which month would you like to travel in?

lines.zh: 这个月份经常下雨。
lines.py: zhè gè yuè fèn jīng cháng xià yǔ .
lines.en: It often rains in this month.

lines.zh: 这本书写了这位画家的一生。
lines.py: zhè běn shū xiě le zhè wèi huà jiā de yī shēng .
lines.en: This book tells the story of the painter's life.

lines.zh: 她把一生的照片整理好了。
lines.py: tā bǎ yī shēng de zhào piān zhěng lǐ hǎo le .
lines.en: She organised her lifetime of photographs.

lines.zh: 我永远记得那次见面。
lines.py: wǒ yǒng yuǎn jì de nà cì jiàn miàn .
lines.en: I'll always remember that meeting.

lines.zh: 她说这个故事永远也讲不完。
lines.py: tā shuō zhè gè gù shì yǒng yuǎn yě jiǎng bù wán .
lines.en: She says she'll never finish telling this story.

audio.py: kuài wǔ diǎn shí , wǒ xiān gào bié . zǒu dào lóu xià , tā hái fā lái xiāo xī , shuō wǒ dài duì le shū , què wàng le bǎ zì jǐ de wéi jīn dài zǒu .
audio.en: Just before five I said goodbye. When I got downstairs she messaged: I'd brought the right book but forgotten to take my own scarf.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二35, 二42, 二36. Native check: telephone 喂 pronunciation, conditional 的话 versus literal words, 不一会儿 interval versus 一会儿 duration, home-visit register and figurative cloud scene. Health words are comprehension examples; no diagnosis, drug choice or dose is taught. Planned retrieval 二30 / 二65 / 二33 / 二56 / 二70: 虽然下雨，但是时间没变。, 门开着，不等于可以直接进去。, 桌上放着书，她还没有读。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Late HSK 2 correction: acquaintances reading a newspaper and planning New Year; a half-hour visit with the right novel and a forgotten scarf; painting an uncooperative cat and visiting an exhibition; old group photos and a sister’s tea shop. Removed app-policy/identity/medical-disclaimer leakage from ordinary speech and replaced metalinguistic word examples with independent situations. All target records get two authored contexts. Preserved old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: suffix 家, 老/小 address forms, 等 list suffix, aspiration 成为/实现, result 成, scope of 以上/以下, 得 dé and 长 zhǎng, concrete medicine nouns 药片/药水 and subject 科. 画儿 remains subject to the explicit unresolved-audio policy, never native-reviewed. Check exact question facts, inclusive age bounds and the teasing tone. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
